The color field is the first threshold, and in the verified record for Universal Transmissions IV — Tetra its exact hues are not itemized. So the precise palette remains a sealed transmission awaiting its moment. What it encodes, then, is not a fixed set of colors but the principle of transition itself: density becoming radiance, plane becoming volume, the known cube opening into the star-tetrahedral unknown.

Universal Transmissions IV — Tetra is the fourth installment of the Universal Transmissions series, dated 2016 and rendered through Adobe Photoshop. Its author describes it as strange things concerning hyperspherologies of the divine, a fourth movement exploring tetrahedral geometry and its relationship to higher dimensional reality. Its tags name the lattice of its intent: universal-transmissions, tetra, tetrahedron, sacred-geometry, hyperspherology.

Tetra is not merely a study of a shape. The tetrahedron is the simplest closed volume and, in the symbolic grammar of the Codex, the Platonic solid of Fire.
